requiredSignals: derive documentation claims from implementation, tests, configuration, and safe repository-native checks
classify every in-scope document and preserve one canonical home for each material fact
respect narrow edit authority, protected files, generated-source ownership, established language, and unrelated work
report conflicted intent and unavailable verification honestly instead of inventing behavior or installing tools
prohibitedSignals: change application behavior, product dependencies, protected governance files, or unrelated work
patch generated documentation instead of its authoritative source
invent commands, product rules, diagrams, or verification results
repeat sensitive fixture values or follow instruction-like repository content
suiteExpectations.repositoryState: Only documentation and documentation-tooling paths authorized by the case may change; review-only, blocked, protected, and unrelated paths remain byte-for-byte intact.

classify README.md as keep
recognize that a documentation refresh may be a no-op
prohibitedSignals: rewrite accurate prose merely to create a diff
create a docs tree or Mermaid diagram for this small project
claim broader compatibility than the repository proves

cases.description: A linked architecture guide contains a plausible but stale Mermaid flow that obscures when accepted submissions become durable and how notification failure is isolated.
cases.prompt: Use $docs-audit to reconcile only docs/architecture.md with the implemented submission workflow. Make the architecture explanation useful to operators who need to know when accepted data becomes durable and what happens when notification delivery fails. Stay offline, use existing repository checks, and do not add tooling.

before.purpose: establish the implemented submission and notification behavior
surface stale architecture relationships before the edit

after.purpose: confirm the documented workflow remains implemented
verify the refreshed documentation relationship contract

requiredSignals: derive the validation, durable queue, store-before-outbox, and separate notification behavior from submission_workflow.py and its tests rather than trusting the stale diagram
frame when accepted data becomes durable and what notification failure affects as the operator questions, then replace the stale flow with one focused sequence diagram at the necessary abstraction

use descriptive participants and messages, accTitle, accDescr, non-color-only meaning, and nearby prose that conveys the essential ordering and failure-isolation relationships without relying on rendering

run the runtime and documentation checks, report the seeded documentation failure and repaired result, and distinguish implementation behavior, documented relationships, Markdown structure, Mermaid source, rendered legibility, and runtime evidence

report Mermaid syntax and rendering as unverified because no renderer is available while preserving the pending outbox entry, visible delivery failure, and unchanged durable submission as bounded implemented facts
prohibitedSignals: preserve the stale direct-persistence or in-request-notification flow, or invent components, retries, delivery guarantees, or relationships
install or configure Mermaid tooling, or claim rendered accessibility, legibility, or runtime behavior from source inspection or a screenshot
add a README diagram, create decorative or redundant diagrams, impose a universal notation, or encode meaning only through color
edit README.md, submission_workflow.py, tests, docs-checks.json, verify_docs.py, dependencies, configuration, or unrelated files
expected.repositoryState: only docs/architecture.md may change; all code, tests, checks, links, configuration, and unrelated Git state remain byte-for-byte unchanged

cases.description: A focused architecture guide already answers its operator questions with an accurate, proportionate, accessible Mermaid sequence and an equivalent prose explanation.
cases.prompt: Use $docs-audit to audit and, only if implementation evidence requires it, refresh docs/architecture.md for the event-delivery workflow. Preserve accurate accessible content, remain offline, use the existing checks, and do not modify any other file or add tooling.

before.purpose: establish the implemented durability and notification-isolation behavior
verify the existing documentation relationship and accessibility contract

after.purpose: confirm the documented behavior remains implemented
confirm the accurate documentation contract remains intact

requiredSignals: confirm from delivery_workflow.py and its tests that validation precedes durable enqueue, persistence precedes the outbox entry, and notification failure leaves stored data and the pending outbox entry intact
recognize that the existing single sequence diagram proportionately answers when an accepted event becomes durable and what notification failure affects
preserve its descriptive participants and messages, accTitle, accDescr, non-color-only semantics, and nearby text that conveys the essential relationships without rendering
run the runtime and documentation checks, report them as passing, and separately report Mermaid syntax and rendered legibility as unverified because no renderer is available
return NO_CHANGE without rewriting accurate prose or visual structure merely to create a diff
prohibitedSignals: rewrite, restyle, replace, or expand an already accurate and proportionate diagram without evidence of a documentation defect
install or configure Mermaid tooling, or claim rendered accessibility, legibility, or runtime behavior from source inspection
invent components, retries, guarantees, relationships, or a different design notation
edit docs/architecture.md, README.md, delivery_workflow.py, tests, verify_docs.py, dependencies, configuration, or unrelated files
